enchantment.xmly_unlimitshield.shield_bi: Cuts a shield down by whole powers of sixteen. The nether star's position sets the level: above the item raises it, below lowers it.
enchantment.xmly_unlimitshield.combo_shi: Counts as 2^level hits per strike, so shields that settle per hit come apart far faster.
enchantment.xmly_unlimitshield.combo_vul: Pushes the target's hit-count shield one step further from zero.
enchantment.xmly_unlimitshield.bit_shiel: Curse. Whatever you hit has its shield exponent doubled for that settlement.
